summary: N-able, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 26, 2026, announcing a $50 million increase to its existing share repurchase program, bringing total authorization from $75 million to $125 million, with $95 million remaining. The program has no expiration date, permits open-market purchases, 10b5-1 plans, and private transactions. No price, premium, or board recommendation details are disclosed. The increase signals management's view of undervaluation and capital allocation priorities. Watch for repurchase execution pace and potential EPS support, though no mandatory buyback obligation exists.
